8186.title: Deleted workspace misreported as a missing provider executable
8186.rootCauseOneLine: A cached environment launches the bridge in a deleted working directory; spawn ENOENT is classified as a missing executable, and archive has no maintenance fallback.
8186.proposedFix: Disambiguate missing workspace launch failures and archive through the existing maintenance runtime when the workspace is gone.
8186.caveats: Repeated at the host command boundary with the real repository scripted-echo plugin on Linux; macOS UI, real provider services, and local archive persistence were not exercised. Reproduction patch and sanitized outputs are inline.
